decisions.reason: As a flagship organic salami line with several variants, it is tightly aligned with the firm's core salami know-how and organic growth path, so the firm can readily learn from market feedback and improve it.

It still draws on established seasoning and sausage-processing capabilities, but the poultry-snack niche looks less central and, after one snack-oriented line was withdrawn, it faces a higher review risk than the main organic salami range.
Organic Fleischwurst builds directly on the firm's traditional boiled-sausage capabilities and new organic assortment, making it a natural fit for existing knowledge and incremental adaptation.

The organic thin-sliced chicken breast line fits the firm's cold-cut portfolio and convenience trend, but poultry-based sliced specialties are somewhat less central than its core pork and salami strengths.

Organic herb-coated salami remains very close to the firm's core salami expertise and stated organic expansion, so the firm has strong capacity to interpret results and refine the product rather than exit it.
